segment.description: Kentucky Lake / Kentucky Reservoir — the TVA mainstream impoundment of the Tennessee River behind Kentucky Dam; 108,217 acres in Tennessee across nine counties (catalog: Hardin, Decatur, Benton, Houston, Stewart) plus 52,083 acres in Kentucky.
